property_summary: For any caller address X and any newOwner Y, if X is not the current owner then calling transferOwnership as X must fail (or not change owner) on the reference contract, but the mutant allowing public transferOwnership will let a non-owner X successfully change owner for some inputs.
change_summary: Removed the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership so anyone can call it; this changes who can set owner and therefore final owner value.
